---
title: "Infographic Visualizations"
format: pdf
---

## Set Up

```{r}
library(tidyverse) # general use
library(janitor) # cleaning data 
library(here) # data organization 
library(lubridate) # date and time 
library(naniar) # to use gg_miss_var

# reading in biomass data
biomass <- read.csv(here("data", 
                      "annual_all_species_fish.csv"),
                 # changing -99999 values to be na
                 na = "-99999")

# reading in bottom temperature data 
bottom_temp <- read.csv(here("data", "Bottom_temp_all_years.csv"),
                        # changing -99999 values to be na
                        na = "-99999")
```

### Visualize Missing Data 

```{r}
#| label: visualizing-missing-biomass-data

# looking at the missing biomass data
biomass_missing <- biomass |> 
  # cleaning names
  clean_names() |> 
  # filter for desired species
  filter(common_name %in% c("California Sheephead", 
                            "Red Urchin", 
                            "Purple Urchin", 
                            "Giant Kelp")) |> 
  # selecting for dry mass and common name
  select(dry_gm2, common_name, site) |> 
  # using gg_miss_var to check for "na" data for species
  gg_miss_var(facet = common_name)

view(biomass_missing)
```

```{r}
#| label: visualizing-missing-bottom-temp-data

# looking at the missing temperature data
temp_missing <- bottom_temp |>  
  # cleaning names
  clean_names() |> 
  # selecting temperature
  select(temp_c) |> 
  # using gg_miss_var to check for "na" data
  gg_miss_var()

view(temp_missing)
```

### Time Series with full_join

#### Clean Data 

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-data-biomass
# creating new object, biomass_clean
biomass_clean <- biomass |> 
  # cleaning names
  clean_names() |>  
  # filtering for desired species 
  filter(common_name %in% c("California Sheephead", 
                            "Red Urchin", 
                            "Purple Urchin", 
                            "Giant Kelp")) |> 
  # renaming date
  rename(original_date = date) |>  
  # using mutate and lubridate to convert original_date 
  # into new date column that can be used to create time series
  mutate(
    date = ymd(original_date),
    year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  # dropping na values to use summarize
  drop_na(dry_gm2) |> 
  # grouping data by year species, and site
  group_by(year,
           common_name,
           site) |> 
  # using summarize to get the mean dry biomass
  # having one mean for each site for each year
  summarize(mean_dry_gm2 = mean(dry_gm2)) |> 
  # ungrouping data 
  ungroup() |> 
  arrange(common_name, year, site)
```

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-data-temp
# creating new object to look at bottom temp data
bottom_temp_clean <- bottom_temp |> 
  # cleaning names
  clean_names() |>
  # using mutate and lubridate to convert date_local
  # into new date column that can be used to create time series
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date_local),
    year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  # grouping data by year
  group_by(year, site) |> 
  # using summarize to get mean temp and make one row per year per site
  summarize(mean_bottom_temp = mean(temp_c)) |> 
  # ungrouping the data 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: checking-calculations_biomass_clean 

check_biomass_mean <- biomass |> 
  clean_names() |>  
  # filtering for desired species 
  filter(common_name %in% c("California Sheephead", 
                            "Red Urchin", 
                            "Purple Urchin", 
                            "Giant Kelp")) |> 
  # renaming date
  rename(original_date = date) |>  
  # using mutate and lubridate to convert original_date 
  # into new date column that can be used to create time series
  mutate(
    date = ymd(original_date),
    year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  # dropping na values to use summarize
  drop_na(dry_gm2) |> 
  arrange(common_name, year, site) |> 
  relocate(year, site, common_name, dry_gm2)
```

#### Joining Datasets


```{r}
#| label: joining-datasets
# creating new object to join datasets
biomass_and_bottom_temp <- full_join(
  biomass_clean,
  bottom_temp_clean,
  # joining data sets by year and site
  by = c("year", 
         "site"))
```

#### Looking at CA Sheephead, Giant Kelp, and Red and Purple Urchins through time

```{r}
#| label: biomass-timeseries
# base layer: ggplot
  ggplot(data = biomass_clean,
       # year on x axis, mean dry biomass on y
       # coloring by species name
       mapping = aes(x = year,
                     y = mean_dry_gm2,
                     color = common_name)) + 
  # second layer: geom_point
  geom_line(aes(group = site),
            linewidth = 0.5,
            alpha = 0.5) + 
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "line",
               aes(group = common_name),
               linewidth = 1) + 
    # customizing x axis year labels for every 3 years
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", 
               date_labels = "%Y") + 
  facet_wrap(~common_name,
             scale = "free_y",
             ncol = 1) + 
  # customizing colors
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Giant Kelp" = "seagreen",
    "California Sheephead" = "dodgerblue4",
    "Purple Urchin" = "purple",
    "Red Urchin" = "firebrick")) + 
  # using labs to label axes
  labs(
    x = "Time (years)",
    y = "Mean dry biomass (g/m^2)") +
  # adding custom theme 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")



ggsave(filename = here("visualizations", "timseries_new.pdf"),
       dpi = 300,
       width = 6,
       height = 8,
       units = "in")
```

#### Looking at temperature (celsius) through time 

##### Mean bottom temperature time series

```{r}
#| label: time-series-mean-bottom-temperature 

# base layer: ggplot
ggplot(bottom_temp_clean) + 
  # x axis year, y axis mean temperature
  aes(x = year,
      y = mean_bottom_temp,
      group = site,
      linetype = site) + 
  # first layer: geom_line

  geom_line(color = "sienna2") +

    color = "sienna2",

  # customizing x axis year labels for every 3 years

               date_labels = "%Y") + 
  # using labs to label x and y axis 
  labs(
    x = "Time (years)",
    y = "Temperature (celcius)") +
  # custom theme
  theme_minimal()
```

### CA Sheephead versus urchin abundance 

#### Clean data

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-urchin-and-sheephead-data

# creating new object to look compare sheephead and urchin biomass
sheephead_and_urchin <- biomass |> 
  # clean names
  clean_names() |>  
  # filtering by urchin and sheephead
  filter(common_name %in% c("California Sheephead", 
                            "Purple Urchin", 
                            "Red Urchin")) |> 
  # renaming date for lubridate adjustment
  rename(original_date = date) |>  
  # using mutate and lubridate to convert original_date
  # into new date column to look at by year
  mutate(
    date = ymd(original_date),
    year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  # dropping missing dry_gm2 values
  drop_na(dry_gm2) |> 
  # grouping by year and common_name
  group_by(year,
           common_name,
           site) |> 
  # using summarize to find mean dry_gm2 and make one row per year
  summarize(mean_dry_gm2 = mean(dry_gm2)) |> 
  # ungrouping
  ungroup() |> 
  # using pivot_wider to look at CA sheephead and urchin as columns with values from mean_dry_gm2
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = common_name,
    values_from = mean_dry_gm2) |> 
  # cleaning names
  clean_names()
```

#### CA Sheephead vs Urchin abundance

```{r}
#| label: visualizing-urchin-and-sheephead-data

# base layer: ggplot
ggplot(sheephead_and_urchin) + 
  # looking at CA sheephead biomass on x axis, purple urchin on y
  aes(x = california_sheephead) + 
  # second layer: geom_point
  geom_point(aes(y = purple_urchin,
                color = "Purple Urchin"),
             alpha = 0.5) +  
  geom_point(aes(y = red_urchin,
                 color = "Red Urchin"),
             alpha = 0.5) + 
  # using labs to label axes
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Purple Urchin" = "purple",
    "Red Urchin" = "firebrick")) + 
  labs(
    x = "California sheephead mean dry biomass (g/m^2)",
    y = "Urchin mean dry biomass (g/m^2)") +
  # custom theme
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Average Biomass and SD Through Years

#### Purple Urchin

```{r}
p_urchin_check <- biomass |> 
  # clean names
  clean_names() |>  
  # filtering for purple urchin
  filter(common_name == "Purple Urchin") |> 
  drop_na(dry_gm2) |> 
  # renaming date for lubridate adjustment
  rename(original_date = date) |>  
  mutate(
    # using mutate and lubridate to convert original_date
  # into new date column to look at by year
    date = ymd(original_date),
    year = floor_date(date, unit = "year"),
    # calculating the total number of observations 
    n_total = n(),
    # finding the overall dry biomass mean across all sites and year
    overall_mean = mean(dry_gm2),
    # calculating difference in dry_gm2 and the overall mean
    dif = dry_gm2 - overall_mean,
    # calculating the square difference
    sq_dif = (dif)^2,
    # taking the sum of these values
    sum_sq = sum(sq_dif),
    # finding the standard deviation from the mean across all sites and years
    overall_sd = sqrt(sum_sq / (n_total - 1)),
    # calculating the z-score
    z = dif / overall_sd) |>
  # arranging data by site and year
  arrange(site, year) |>
  # selecting for desired columns
  select(site, year, dry_gm2, overall_mean, dif, sq_dif, n_total, sum_sq, overall_sd, z) 
```

```{r}
# creating new object 
p_urchin_sd <- p_urchin_check |> 
  # grouping by site and year
  group_by(site, year) |> 
  # using summarize to get one z-score for each year at one site
  summarize(z = mean(z)) |> 
  # using mutate to create Before, During, After periods
  # during meaning the blob (2014-2015)
  mutate (period = case_when(
      year < ymd("2014-01-01") ~ "Before",
      year <= ymd("2015-01-01") ~ "During",
      year > ymd("2015-01-01") ~ "After")) |> 
  # using fct_relevel to order periods chronologically
  mutate(period = fct_relevel(period,
                              "Before",
                              "During",
                              "After"))
```

```{r}
# base layer: ggplot
ggplot(data = p_urchin_sd,
       # x-axis: period, y-axis: z-score
       mapping = aes(x = period,
                     y = z,
                     # coloring by period
                     color = period)) + 
  # first layer: geom_jitter
  geom_jitter() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Before" = "deepskyblue",
    "During" = "darkorange",
    "After" = "deepskyblue")) + 
  # custom theme
  theme_minimal() + 
  # removing legend
  theme(legend.position = "NONE")
```

#### Red Urchin

```{r}
r_urchin_avg_biomass <- biomass |> 
  # clean names
  clean_names() |>  
  # filtering for red urchin
  filter(common_name == "Red Urchin") |> 
  drop_na(dry_gm2) |> 
  # renaming date for lubridate adjustment
  rename(original_date = date) |>  
  # using mutate and lubridate to convert original_date
  # into new date column to look at by year
  mutate(
    date = ymd(original_date),
    year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  # using mutate 
  mutate(
    # finding overall dry biomass mean
    overall_mean = mean(dry_gm2),
    # finding overall sd of biomass 
    overall_sd = sd(dry_gm2),
    # calculating sd from the mean
    sd_from_mean = (dry_gm2 - overall_mean) / overall_sd,
    # creating new column to display periods in relation to
    # the blob event (2014-2015)
    period = case_when(
      year < ymd("2014-01-01") ~ "Before",
      year <= ymd("2015-01-01") ~ "During",
      year > ymd("2015-01-01") ~ "After")) |> 
  # using fct_relevel to order periods chronologically
  mutate(period = fct_relevel(period,
                              "Before",
                              "During",
                              "After")) |> 
# grouping data by year and period for summarize
  group_by(year, period) |> 
  # using summarize to find the average sd from mean per year
  summarize(
    sd_from_mean = mean(sd_from_mean)) |> 
  # ungrouping data 
  ungroup() 
```

```{r}
# base layer: ggplot
ggplot(data = r_urchin_avg_biomass,
       # x-axis: period, y-axis: sd_from_mean
       mapping = aes(x = period,
                     y = sd_from_mean,
                     # coloring by period
                     color = period)) + 
  # first layer: geom_jitter
  geom_jitter() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Before" = "deepskyblue",
    "During" = "darkorange",
    "After" = "deepskyblue")) + 
  # custom theme
  theme_minimal() + 
  # removing legend
  theme(legend.position = "NONE")
```
